_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
I kɛ́ yɛ́ Mogɛnɛ {player_id} Tic Tac Toe la.
I kɛ́ yɛ́ tɛ́mɛ̀ɛmɛ̀ wɔɔrɛ̀ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ wɔɔrɛ̀ la (tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀, wɔɔrɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀, wɔɔlɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀) wɔɔ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ la.
I kɛ́ yɛ́ tɛ́mɛ̀ɛmɛ̀ wɔɔrɛ̀ la, i kɛ́ yɛ́ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ wɔɔ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ la (0-8) i kɛ́ yɛ́ wɔɔ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ la.
Wɔɔrɛ̀ '[4]' wɔɔ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ la, i kɛ́ yɛ́ wɔɔ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ la tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ wɔɔ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ la.
I kɛ́ yɛ́ Mogɛnɛ {player_id}, i kɛ́ yɛ́ '{symbol}', wɔɔ i kɛ́ yɛ́ tɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ɛ̀ la '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: B sẽn da gʋls n na n kẽngã pa zems ne b sẽn dat-a to-to wã ye.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} pa cell sẽn zems ye. A segd n yɩɩ 0 ne 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} zoe n bee neba sʋka.

game_action.placed: Laɣim ŋun nyɛ {player_id} daa zaɛ laɣim ({symbol}) tiŋgbani ni {cell}.
